Title: Veduta del porto di ancona

Abstract: Print shows a view of the port of Ancona with several sailing ships, rowboats, and activity on a wharf. Physical description: 1 print : engraving ; sheet 30.7 x 46.7 cm.

Notes: Title from item.; Blind stamped on lower left, in oval: ADI.; Forms part of: Popular graphic art print filing series (Library of Congress).; Gift; Louise McDanell Browne, in memory of her husband C.A. Browne; 1948 April 27.; Trimmed to within plate mark at top.; Printed at top center: No. 2.; L. De Vegni inc.; Stamped on verso: Gift. Louise
